newsitem.title: USA: US Midcontinent diesel basis firms on refiner buys.
newsitem.headline: US Midcontinent diesel basis firms on refiner buys.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent diesel fuel differentials gathered more strength Thursday as major refiners continued to buy barrels to squirrel away ahead of upcoming maintenance turnarounds in the region, players said.
Traders said diffs on low sulfur diesel firmed one cent in both centers, to a half cent over March NYMEX heat in Group Three and to even with the March print in Chicago.
"Refiners are stepping up to buy ahead of the late-February and March turnarounds. They're loading up their retail systems," one player said, saying most of the focus was on low sulfur diesel.

Differentials on conventional unleaded gasoline eased about 0.25 cent, traders said, to 0.75 cent below the March print in both centers -- giving up part of the gains seen Wednesday also on refiner buying.
Premium gasoline was offered at 2.0 cents over conventional unleaded in the Group and about 1.75 cents over in Chicago, traders said.
